test_handle_local_states: test the pz.de.handle_local_states function to wrap a model and extract mutable local state for lazy or eager evaluation
test_freeze_local_states: test the pz.de.freeze_local_states function to freeze mutable local state back into a model as FrozenLocalStateRequest objects
test_hoist_shared_state_requests: test the pz.de.hoist_shared_state_requests function to hoist duplicate shared state requests from nested lists into a flat structure
test_state_sharing: test the pz.de.handle_local_states function with state_sharing modes forbidden, allowed, and unsafe for duplicate named state requests
test_category_predicate: test the pz.de.handle_local_states function with a category_predicate to filter which local state categories are handled
